segments: Once the code and audio sequence is complete, the rooftop plane becomes the final trigger. No fuel is required for this flight.
This is the point where a solo run stops. The final bridge fight requires multiple players, and a two- or three-player game needs Weasel present.
Enter Afterlife and interact with the rooftop plane. It does not need fuel; the team is transported to the bridge in Afterlife.
This final flight cannot be completed solo.
There is no normal boarding prompt; interact with the plane while in Afterlife.
Revive yourselves from the electric chairs on the bridge to begin the final showdown.
The final fight is Weasel versus the other mobsters. Weasel wins by killing the others; the others win by killing Weasel.
Weasel is ignored by the zombies during the showdown and has increased durability to offset being outnumbered.
If Weasel wins, the cycle is broken; if the other mobsters kill Weasel, the cycle continues.
Either outcome completes Pop Goes the Weasel and ends the game.
